facts.text: All first-year students must take the two-semester Augustine and Culture Seminar sequence.

sources.title: Fulfilling Core Curriculum Course Requirements | Villanova University
sources.quote: ACS is reading- and writing- intensive, and consequently this two-semester course sequence must be taken by all students during the first year of study.

facts.text: Students admitted to Villanova as residential students are guaranteed on-campus housing for three consecutive years.

sources.title: On-Campus Living | Villanova University
sources.quote: Students who are admitted to the University as a “resident” are guaranteed three consecutive years (six consecutive semesters) of on-campus housing
